 Mon, 2 November 2026 
 By TRN Online, Kathmandu, Nov 2: Kathmandu Gorkhas has secured its first win in the Nepal Premier League (NPL) games played so far by defeating Karnali Yaks today by four wickets. 
 The Kathmandu Gorkhas met the target of 181 runs set by the Karnali in 19.4 overs with loss of six wickets.
